scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-relief/shared build && pnpm --filter @open-relief/db build && pnpm --filter @open-relief/api build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.setup.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @open-relief/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-relief/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-relief/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @open-relief/mobile typecheck
scripts.preview:web: EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 pnpm --filter @open-relief/mobile exec expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-web && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/serve-web-preview.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @open-relief/shared test && pnpm --filter @open-relief/db test && pnpm --filter @open-relief/api test
